request.description:
Update an existing quotation.
- Old stock is reversed automatically.
- New items are inserted and stock is reduced.
- charges[] replaces old charges (send empty array [] to remove all).
- voucher_no can be changed (leave it out to keep existing number).
- Works on draft or posted quotations (not cancelled).
Cancel a quotation. Stock that was reduced on creation is added back automatically.
